rules.title: Berkeley Ord. 7,992-N.S.: coordinated pricing algorithms (BMC ch. 13.63)
rules.requirement: It is unlawful to sell, license or provide to Berkeley landlords a coordinated pricing algorithm that sets or recommends rents or occupancy levels, and unlawful for a landlord to use one when setting rents or occupancy levels for residential dwelling units in Berkeley. Operative status cannot be established from this document.
rules.key_value: Civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation; each month and each unit is a separate violation

coverage_conditions.note: Residential dwelling units in the City of Berkeley, if and when the ordinance is in force.

rules.exemptions: The definition excludes aggregated anonymous reports, affordable-housing limit tools, and market research, appraisal and software research or testing.
rules.citation: Berkeley Municipal Code ch. 13.63, sec. 13.63.030 (Ordinance No. 7,992-N.S.)
rules.quoted_span: It shall be unlawful for a landlord to use a coordinated pricing algorithm described in subsection A when setting rents or occupancy levels for residential dwelling units in the City of Berkeley.
